clips.title: The story
paras: Among the Faithful follows an undercover investigation into the Faithful of Al'Akir stationed at Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands. By blending in as a prospective recruit, an adventurer learns that the cult's supreme leadership is secretly gathering to launch an imminent offensive against local settlements and outposts.

Posing as an eager recruit among the Faithful of Al'Akir, an infiltrator enters Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands. The cultists openly celebrate their growing ranks, boasting that their collective devotion lends shape and fury to the storm itself. New arrivals are typically sent directly to Skypriest Aanders for scrutiny, but an unexpected meeting at the local inn disrupts normal protocol.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.
For now, just don't get in anyone's way.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!
If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... Why the watchtower?
The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.
Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.
